name: Aes67AvailableStreamDescriptor
comment: Descriptor of an AES67 stream discovered from external sources. Uniqueness is defined by the composite key (IDExternal, SourceID), not by IDExternal alone.

properties.name: IDExternal
properties.comment: External ID of endpoint as provided by the source. This value is only unique within the context of SourceID.

properties.name: AlignmentLevel
properties.comment: Alignment level of the stream endpoint. Optional if available.

properties.name: SecurityType
properties.comment: Security type of this stream, if any.

properties.name: SourceID
properties.comment: Identifier of source catalog/announcement that provided this stream (e.g. NMOS registry, SAP domain). Together with IDExternal, this forms the unique stream identity.

properties.name: Timestamp
properties.comment: Time when this stream information was recorded or created.
